report_notes: RoadRunner v3 is 3.0.0, measured on October 13 with PHP 8.5.11, 20 workers, PostgreSQL max_connections=2000, and the same 32-thread, 256-connection ramp settings as the earlier sessions. RoadRunner v2025 retains the October 5 measurements of 2025.1.15; these are separate sessions with different background activity and Docker versions, not a simultaneous controlled A/B test.

RoadRunner v3 keeps configuration version 3 and reverses the HTTP middleware list to [gzip, static] to preserve the v2025 execution order. Both versions use the same locked PHP dependencies and worker entry point; the executable is supplied by the corresponding pinned Docker image, independently of the Composer spiral/roadrunner metapackage.

Both RoadRunner v3 endpoint ramps completed all 13 stages with zero recorded request errors. No PHP application errors were logged. Throughput saturation and overload latency remain visible in the report.
